craft_notes: Sthāyin: assertion of sole agency. Device: end-dash→comma (all let be, maker stated softly). Rejected: 'free agent' modernising kartā — killed: maker/doer kept, office slang refused. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: At each emprise, Bhava — deed, tool, cosmos be as they be,
the unbound maker there is thee alone.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ārambhe bhava sarvatra karma vā karaṇādi vā viśvam astu svatantras tu kartā tatraikako bhavān

reads_against.argmap: In every undertaking, O Bhava — act or means-and-rest or all, let be.; But the free doer therein alone is you. → Amid all acts and means, you alone are the free doer.
c1_essence: Free doer alone amid all acts; seized worlds need none else's might or mercy.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with audārya (generosity tasted and returned)
reads_against.l2: Let every venture start, O Bhava — deed, instrument, world, what you will — yet the deed's free master there is you alone.
l3: At each emprise, Bhava — deed, tool, cosmos be as they be —
the unbound maker there is thee alone.
